data.title: 神裂火织 · 堕天使女仆装的极致羞愤端茶
data.description: 高级常盘台公馆客厅内，被迫穿上天草式特制“堕天使女仆装”的神裂火织双手端着红茶托盘，低着头从耳根一直红到脖颈，咬紧红唇羞耻得几乎想要自刎。
data.location: luxurious western parlor room with ornate carpet, sofa, and crystal chandelier
data.action: standing stiffly holding a silver tea service tray, head bowed deeply with extreme blushing face, biting lip in mortified indignation
data.lighting: 客厅水晶吊灯暖光与窗外斜阳
data.promptProse: Kaori Kanzaki stands rigidly holding a tea tray in her backless Fallen Angel maid attire, head bowed in agonizing, mortified embarrassment.
data.animaCaption: Chandelier light glints on the silver tea tray as crimson blushes cover her face down to her neck.
